summary.en: Three cards slam into their slots on an even beat; every hit freezes the frame for two frames, punches a number up off the card and steps a ×N counter up; a closing line rises after the third.
summary.zh: 三张卡按均匀节拍接连砸进槽位；每一击全画面顿两帧、从卡面打出一个数字上浮、右上角 ×N 计数跳一级；第三击后收尾一行升起。

fits: Three features or gains that add up, told as a combo: each one lands with its number and the total builds.
notFor: Serious or quiet films (it is an arcade joke); more or fewer than three items; numbers that are not gains.

overlaps.note: one card slamming in; combo-hits chains three falls with a hit-stop, numbers and a counter
its hit-stop mode holds content per hit; combo-hits uses its hitStop() as the clock
a number counting to its result; combo-hits steps a counter once per hit

intent.en: Three gains land like hits in a fighting game, so the total feels earned and fun.
intent.zh: 三项收益像格斗游戏的连招一样一击一击打出来，让总数显得来得爽快。

content.en: Exactly three cards: a title ≤ 16 chars, an optional meta line ≤ 22 chars and a gain ≤ 8 chars each; a counter label ≤ 8 chars; an optional closing line ≤ 36 chars.
content.zh: 正好三张卡：每张标题 ≤ 6 字、可选说明 ≤ 9 字、收益数字 ≤ 5 字；计数标签 ≤ 3 字；可选收尾一句 ≤ 14 字。

fits.zh: 三个加起来的功能或收益，讲成连招：每项带着数字落地，总数一路攀升。

notFor.zh: 严肃或安静的片子（它是街机梗）；不是三项；不是收益的数字。

pairs.note: the summed total as one number after the combo

en: The hit-stop freezes the whole picture; a background that keeps moving through it breaks the hit.
Numbers must grow hit by hit; a smaller third hit deflates the combo.
zh: 顿帧要全画面一起停；背景照动就打不出命中感。
数字要一击比一击大；第三击变小，连招就泄气。

upstream.name: 连招计数
upstream.summary: 三卡接连砸入，每命中 = 顿帧 2f + 伤害数字上浮 + ×N 计数跳字逐次加码
upstream.use: 元素落位/撞击的"命中一瞬"——给砸入、撞停加游戏级手感；按强度阶梯选式
